avis.titre: With winter drying out my skin...
avis.texte: With winter drying out my skin and causing some dead skin cells to build up, I came across the Mediheal exfoliating pads. Given their popularity, I decided to give them a try and have been using them for about a month now. I've used various pads from other brands, but these are by far the thickest I've encountered, with a somewhat stiff texture. One side has an embossed surface for tackling sebum and dead skin cells, while the smooth side offers a gentler option. As someone with super sensitive skin, I find the embossed side can be a bit harsh at times, so I alternate these with other products to avoid daily use. After using them, my skin definitely feels smooth and radiant, with a noticeable glow. Just remember, that glow is temporary, so follow up with your skincare routine right away! While the price is a bit on the higher side, you do get a good amount of pads. However, the amount of serum in each pad seems quite limited. The pads are just barely saturated, with absolutely no excess serum. If you have sensitive skin, it's best to use the embossed side sparingly and adjust usage as needed!

If you want to manage dead skin cells on areas like elbows or knees, I'd recommend this. It's moisturizing, so it's great for taking care of those areas too.

It's amazing at smoothing out dead skin cells. When I apply makeup after using this pad, my foundation goes on flawlessly! The adhesion is non­existent, and those with sensitive skin might experience some irritation when using it as an exfoliating toner.

Although they're exfoliating pads, I appreciated that they weren't overly harsh. They're perfect for gentle daily dead skin cell care. What I loved most was the square shape of the pads. Compared to round ones, these made it easier to exfoliate tricky areas like around the nose and eyes. I hope this could be improved. Sensitive skin types might find these a bit irritating, especially when exfoliating. It's great to put these on while blow­drying your hair ­ it helps prevent your skin from getting too dry.

While it was great for soothing, it didn't quite tackle my dead skin cells, so I mainly used it as a quick mask while drying my hair. After finishing that tub, I decided to try these exfoliating pads due to their good reviews, and wow... they've become my ultimate toner pads! Compared to the Tea Tree pads, these feel a bit stiffer and thicker. This makes them perfect for evening out skin texture with the embossed side. The synergy between the essence and the pad is just right. The scent isn't off­putting at all, and when I pat it into my skin after smoothing or using as a quick mask, it feels like it's firming up my skin from within. It even seems to make my makeup apply better. I'd heard that toner pads could actually be harmful and irritating to the skin, so for a while, I switched to layering plain toners. But unless I used separate exfoliating products like peeling gels or enzyme cleansers, I actually experienced more blemishes than when I was using toner pads. Is it just me? Personally, I find peeling gels, enzyme cleansers, and peel­off masks too harsh ­ they make my skin feel uncomfortable. So I bought these more for exfoliation than as a quick mask. In conclusion, I've repurchased after finishing a whole tub ­ that's how much of a staple these have become in my routine. I can't imagine going bac

I LOVE this product, I use trentinoin and this product has helped my dry flakey skin without distrupting my skin barrier. My skin feels smoother, nourished and overall healthier! My only con is the smell can be a little off putting at first, kinda smells of tea tree. But once it dries down I dont notice the smell!
After just a few days of using the product, my skin was a lot smoother. I'll definitely try the other toner pads.

avis.titre: What I liked better than other...
avis.texte: What I liked better than other brands was the pad material ­ it's not paper or cotton­like, but more like clear tape with visible fibers? That was great! I use it after cleansing and before makeup, and it reduces the appearance of cakey makeup, so I'm a big fan! Opening the packaging is quite challenging. It seems they've really focused on hygiene since it's used on the face, and the sealing is very nice indeed! Use this after cleansing and before applying your skincare products. It's best to use the slightly textured side on areas with dead skin cells, and for super sensitive skin, flip it over and gently pat it on.

Heard a lot about this product and I decided to try it. It's a good product. I usually put mine on my mini skincare fridge, that way it stays cool. The product is not that sticky, I just wash my hands after applying it in my face. I also use the tweezers to pat it down/spread it on my face, that way I don't have to touch it with my whole hands. The smell is bearable depending on the person's sensitivity for smell. It's not a bad smell, it has a kind of sweet smell to it. The effectiveness of the product is also good. I noticed some changes in my skin. Overall, I like this product and would reccommend it. But, it's not for eveyone. it just depends in your skin

The oil and moisture balance is great! For my combination skin with dry and oily areas, it smooths out the dry parts and controls excess oil in the oily areas. It's an excellent pad for refining skin texture right after cleansing! The quantity offers good value for money, and the tweezers can be conveniently attached to the lid. Above all, the pads are **nice and thick!** Those with super sensitive skin might experience a slight tingling sensation. On days when I have blemishes, it stings a bit, but afterwards my skin feels calmed, so it's okay. It's best to buy this when there's a promotion, as they often give about 10 extra pads gratis

avis.titre: I used this only in the...
avis.texte: I used this only in the evenings for dead skin cell control. During the period I used it, I saw positive effects on my pores. I wouldn't recommend this for those with super sensitive skin. I had to avoid using it on areas with atopic dermatitis.

avis.titre: * I have dry skin that lacks...
avis.texte: * I have dry skin that lacks hydration * My skin is oily on the surface but feels tight underneath, with deep dryness * While not super sensitive, I'm prone to blemishes ­ I love that the dedicated tongs are attached to the lid, preventing loss ­ The pads are quite large, making them great for both wiping and as a toner mask ­ It provides instant dead skin cell removal and a glowing effect, significantly improving skin texture before makeup ­ The biggest advantage is the ability to manage dead skin cells daily without irritation ­ The product has a noticeable scent, which may not appeal to everyone ­ It lacks moisture, so be sure to replenish hydration after using the pads for skin prep

avis.titre: After using it, my skin feels...
avis.texte: After using it, my skin feels smooth and hydrated! There's no tightness. For areas with many blemishes, I recommend gently wiping the product.

I usually use this before applying makeup, and there's a noticeable difference between days when I use it and when I don't. On days I use it, it smooths out dead skin cells, making my makeup look flawless. But on days I skip it, my skin feels a bit dry and my makeup doesn't sit as well. It's definitely effective at managing dead skin cells, so it's become a staple in my routine! There's also plenty of ampoule in the product. Even though I accidentally spilled all the ampoule a month ago, the pad still maintains its hydration. It's amazing! The tweezer stand seems to be a bit weak, as it keeps coming loose and falling off. This makes me feel it's not very hygienic. When you open the lid, you have to pick up the fallen tweezers with your hands, and then they fall off again, which is a bit frustrating. If only the stand stayed in place, it would be perfect!

The essence seems to be well­absorbed into the pads. I also really loved that it comes with tweezers. The pads are a bit thicker than I expected, so they don't seem to adhere well. Unfortunately, when I use this, I get small bumps on my face, so I can't use it regularly. I've had to put it away for now. I'm planning to use it sparingly when my skin is in better condition. I didn't see any noticeable effects on blemishes or dead skin cells. I'm not sure which ingredient is causing the issue. Some people say it works wonders for them, but why doesn't it work for me? It's frustrating trying to figure it out.

avis.titre: This is a product I keep...
avis.texte: This is a product I keep repurchasing. With consistent use, I've seen great results for uneven texture, overall skin texture, and especially for blackheads on my nose area! I recommend using it according to your skin type, as daily use might cause irritation for some people.

avis.titre: When I use this before bed, my...
avis.texte: When I use this before bed, my skin definitely feels smooth and silky in the morning It feels like it's just sitting on top of my skin rather than absorbing well, and doesn't seem to settle in properly

avis.titre: I loved how it seemed to...
avis.texte: I loved how it seemed to remove dead skin cells and reduce sebum production I didn't notice any dramatic changes and it didn't seem particularly effective

avis.titre: There were days when my makeup...
avis.texte: There were days when my makeup applied beautifully, which was wonderful. My skin felt softer, and it seemed to calm my blemishes too. It was frustrating that the pad kept falling off my face. Not all sides of the pad adhered well to the skin, you know? I found it quite effective to apply acne medication first and then put the pad on top.

avis.titre: It was better than I expected.
avis.texte: It was better than I expected. I've used over 5 bottles of this product over a long period. I don't think this product suits me. When I was using it, my skin felt dry and my dead skin cells became more noticeable. These issues disappeared after I switched to a different product. If you have combination dehydrated skin like me and plan to use this, make sure to supplement with other hydrating products to maintain moisture balance.
I just started using this product about 2 weeks ago. It has kept hormonal acne at bay! I am a Tretioin user and it's gentle enough to use between treatments 2 X a week. Big fan.

Exfoliating pads used every 2­3 days Feels like it refines facial texture after use Generous pad size for comfortable application Built­in tweezers for hygienic use Dual­sided pads for gentle cleansing or dead skin cell removal I'm already on my 3rd or 4th container. This product works hard for me! The only downside is that the adhesive seal on new products is a bit too strong, making it slightly difficult to open by hand.

Exfoliating pads used every 2­3 days Feels like it refines facial texture after use Generous pad size for comfortable application Built­in tweezers for hygienic use Dual­sided pads for gentle cleansing or dead skin cell removal I'm already on my 3rd or 4th container. This product works hard for me! The only downside is that the adhesive seal on new products is a bit too strong, making it slightly difficult to open by hand.
I loved this product. It has smooth out my skin and my skin complexion is radiant.

avis.titre: I love this and will be buying again!
avis.texte: These toner oads saved my skin. While i do break out sometimes the pads help reduce the redness and inflammation. They do not burn when going over an active pimple. The pads helped reduce pore visibility and those small bumps on my forehead and temple areas. The only thing that im sad about is that theyre 24 dollars…but theres 90 or 100 pads so they last. I will definitely buy them again and the different pads if this brand.

Perfect for smoothing out texture on my combination dehydrated skin. Without exfoliation, sebum builds up quickly causing uneven skin, but this product is great for refining skin texture. It doesn't completely prevent blemishes or textural issues. Also, it doesn't adhere well enough to use as a leave­on mask.

The ultimate champion for dead skin cell removal... I didn't even feel like I did much, but in just 5 minutes, those pesky flakes are completely eradicated! The container is also so pretty that I love having it on display on my desk! It's so effective at removing dead skin cells that if you leave it on even a little too long, your skin can become red and oily. It feels like it's stripping away your skin barrier, so for maximum efficiency, use it quickly and gently.

avis.titre: Great for daily care and dead...
avis.texte: Great for daily care and dead skin cell management on oily skin. Leave it on for 10 minutes and your skin feels incredibly soft! However, the pad might not feel gentle enough for those who prefer a softer touch. The fermented ingredients can work differently for each person. Maybe my expectations were too high, but it fell a bit short. Still, it was decent overall.

avis.titre: I bought this product on a...
avis.texte: I bought this product on a whim during a sale at Olive Young. While I often receive compliments on my skin, I personally felt that my skin texture wasn't great when I touched it. However, since using this product, my skin feels incredibly smooth! I used it every morning, and now that my skin texture has improved significantly, I use it every other day. If you find the exfoliating ingredients a bit harsh, I recommend using it every other day like I do! The only downside for me is that I wish it provided a bit more hydration. As it's currently focused on dead skin cell removal, it might feel a bit dry when used indoors during the peak of winter.
This product no joke has changed my skin in a few weeks. I'm kind of speechless. Just go ahead and use this daily and see for yourself.

avis.titre: When my skin texture isn't at...
avis.texte: When my skin texture isn't at its best, using this makes my skin feel incredibly soft the next day. It seems to gently remove dead skin cells. Since it's meant for exfoliation, the fabric feels a bit stiff. Those with super sensitive skin should use it with a light touch, gently gliding it over the skin.

avis.titre: I'm using this as a refill and...
avis.texte: I'm using this as a refill and it has a different power compared to tea tree! I have sensitive skin, but I can't really find any downsides to this product! I plan to purchase the full­size version and give it a try.

avis.titre: Got rid of stubborn acne in less than a week
avis.texte: Ive had a stubborn area on my temple that has had acne reoccuring and seemingly never healing for a few months. Right when one bump goes away another pops back up. The pores there also were very dilated. Since using this product, for less than a week, those pores have become less noticeable and the acne is healing fast. All the redness is gone. The pores on my nose have also become less noticeable. Unlike other reviews, I dont notice a smell.

avis.titre: It's just a basic pad I use...
avis.texte: It's just a basic pad I use for evening out my skin tone. Pretty standard and gets the job done. I couldn't really notice any significant effects, so it felt like a bit of a waste of money.

Effective for managing sebum and removing dead skin cells. I love that there's a groove on the lid where you can insert the tweezers. The pads are a bit rough, and my skin feels quite dry after use, so you'll need to follow up with plenty of hydration.
Just started using this product. So far, so good. No irritation or adverse reaction to it. Not drying. I hope it ends up working well, I'll have to re­review.
I am 67 years old and this photo enzyme is luxurious . i gave some to a friend after 1 week of using.
I love these ! Got rid of my texture and is a great gentle exfoliate for my sensitive acne prone skin.
